metadata.note: Empirical metrics are derived directly from real runs on the 53-query benchmark. Advanced paradigms are analyzed qualitatively per literature specifications without fabricated metrics.

empirical_implemented_systems.model: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60, alpha=0.5) over FTS5 + Hash-128

empirical_implemented_systems.name: Hybrid BM25 + MiniLM-L6-v2 (RRF, Neural Hybrid)

qualitative_literature_survey.primary_citation: Yan et al., 'Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation', arXiv:2401.15884, 2024
qualitative_literature_survey.retrieval_and_filtering: Retrieval evaluator assigns confidence score (Correct, Ambiguous, Incorrect). If incorrect/ambiguous, triggers web search fallback.
qualitative_literature_survey.offline_feasibility: Infeasible in strictly air-gapped or offline enterprise deployments due to core dependence on live external web search fallback.
qualitative_literature_survey.citation_granularity: Document / URL level; does not map dual physical and printed page coordinates or clause-level cryptographic hashes.
qualitative_literature_survey.computational_overhead: Requires separate evaluator model (e.g., T5) plus multiple web query expansions.

qualitative_literature_survey.primary_citation: Asai et al., 'Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection', ICLR 2024
qualitative_literature_survey.retrieval_and_filtering: Decodes reflection tokens ([Retrieve], [IsRel], [IsSup], [IsUse]) during generation to dynamically evaluate relevance and support.
qualitative_literature_survey.offline_feasibility: Feasible offline if model weights are hosted locally, but requires fine-tuned specialized open-weights models (e.g. 7B/13B parameters).
qualitative_literature_survey.citation_granularity: Sentence-level reflection tokens; does not maintain verified physical insurance page numbers.
qualitative_literature_survey.computational_overhead: High beam-search decode overhead across reflection tokens; impractical on resource-constrained pure-CPU hardware.

qualitative_literature_survey.primary_citation: Edge et al., 'From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization', arXiv:2404.16130, 2024
qualitative_literature_survey.retrieval_and_filtering: Extracts knowledge graph entities, relationships, and hierarchical Leiden communities to generate macro-level summaries.
qualitative_literature_survey.offline_feasibility: Feasible offline once graph is built, but index generation requires hundreds of LLM calls per document.
qualitative_literature_survey.citation_granularity: Community report and entity subgraphs; obscures exact physical PDF page clause boundaries required for legal disputes.
qualitative_literature_survey.computational_overhead: Prohibitive offline indexing cost and memory graph traversal complexity.

qualitative_literature_survey.retrieval_and_filtering: Dual-tier BM25 + subword feature hash / MiniLM with deterministic keyword-overlap evidence gating (m >= 2) and hard abstention.
qualitative_literature_survey.offline_feasibility: Fully offline and air-gapped; pure-CPU execution with zero external cloud dependencies and optional neural embedding upgrade.
qualitative_literature_survey.citation_granularity: Dual physical and printed page numbers, section headings, and SHA-256 chunk content digests.
qualitative_literature_survey.computational_overhead: Under 10 ms pure-CPU latency on SQLite FTS5; sub-millisecond feature hash projection.
